_comment: Storage term emails (STORAGE_REDESIGN_PLAN.md decisions 7 and 21), sent by expire-shares.yml (daily) and delete-long-shelved.yml (weekly) in MorphoCloudWorkflow. Plain text; the consumer substitutes the placeholders. Placeholders: {{kept_until}} (the expiry date) {{delete_on}} {{days_left}} {{grace_days}} {{term_days}} {{today}} {{note_line}} {{instance_name}} {{days}} {{login}} {{reason}} {{asked}} {{link}} {{portal_url}} {{contact_email}}.
reminder_subject: Your MorphoCloud storage will expire on {{kept_until}}
reminder_body:
Your MorphoCloud storage (MyDrive) will expire on {{kept_until}}.

If you still need it after that date, sign in to the portal, press "Ask to keep my storage" and tell us in a few words why you need it: {{portal_url}}
A MorphoCloud admin will review your request.

If it is not extended, your instance is deleted after {{kept_until}}, MyDrive is locked for {{grace_days}} days, and then it is deleted with every file in it. There is no backup: download anything you want to keep.

If you have questions, contact {{contact_email}}.
approved_subject: Your MorphoCloud storage now expires on {{kept_until}}
declined_subject: Your request to keep your MorphoCloud storage
admin_reminder_subject: Storage request from {{login}} is still waiting
shelved_deleted_body:
Your MorphoCloud instance {{instance_name}} was deleted because it was not used: it had been shelved for more than {{days}} days.

Your files in MyDrive are safe. MyDrive expires on {{kept_until}}.

You can create a new instance from the portal at any time: {{portal_url}}

If you have questions, contact {{contact_email}}.
